records.notes: Directly supports difficulty treating ruler units as spatial intervals and shows shifted-start tasks can expose shallow read-off or mark-counting strategies.

The hour hand was significantly more challenging to position accurately than the minute hand; approaches included multiplicative hour-minute reasoning, part-whole reasoning and matching numerals. Supports targeted clock-hand probes, not one universal misconception.
